$Comment: The T4 find table, middle floor of band B (score 200, which no single source reaches alone - it wants two skill trees invested and real levels behind them). Two byproduct pulls, then 35 percent for 1 to 7 essence and 5 percent for 1 to 2 CONCENTRATED, so the concentrated payout doubles while staying as scarce as T3's. Offcuts come from RPG Stations' own shared RPG_Station_Sawmill_Byproducts list, referenced by id through a Droplist container rather than listed here, so retuning what milling yields is one edit in that file and every tier in both mods moves together.
